evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml (step1.patch l.42-79) runs on pull_request and runs `npm ci`, `npm test` and `npm run build` in site/. All of these scripts exist in app/site/package.json (test with pretest→prepare-data, and build runs svelte-check + vite build). Top-level `permissions: contents: read` everywhere. pages.yml triggers only on push to main (and workflow_dispatch), gives `pages: write`/`id-token: write` only to the deploy job, and passes PAGES_BASE, which app/site/vite.config.ts:11 really reads. release.yml grants contents: write at job level, uses only `github.token`, and checks that the tagged commit is on main. There is no pull_request_target and nothing was pushed or run. However, every action is referenced by a mutable tag rather than a full commit SHA: actions/checkout@v7, setup-node@v7, configure-pages@v6, upload-pages-artifact@v5, deploy-pages@v5 (step1.patch l.62,64,110,112,118,133,150,180,216).
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch l.415-510) covers requirements, install (`cd site; npm ci`), develop (`npm run dev`), test (`npm test`, filter example), build (`npm run build`, PAGES_BASE), data contribution (issue forms that exist in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE, editing records under data/, link to CONTRIBUTING#data-records) and license (MIT LICENSE, THIRD-PARTY.md, both present). Every script shown (dev, test, build, prepare-data, sample-bullets, preview) exists in site/package.json. The claim that prepare-data copies the flags matches site/scripts/build-index.mjs:24-25.
evidence.s1_release: CONTRIBUTING.md#Versioning: SemVer, version kept in site/package.json (0.1.0) and the lockfile, tags `v<version>`, with pre-1.0 rules. #Releasing: release PR with `npm version --no-git-tag-version`, changelog rename, `chore(release)` commit, then pushing the tag. release.yml enforces tag = package version and the `## [X.Y.Z] - ` heading, and extracts the notes. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and its heading rules. dependabot.yml covers npm in /site (the only package.json) and github-actions, with convention-matching prefixes. The Conventional Commits convention is stated in detail, and all 8 commits in commits.txt follow it (ci:, ci(release):, ci(deps):, docs:, feat(site):, fix(site):).
evidence.s2_requirements: Route `#/compare/<a>/<b>` is parsed in router.ts:34-45 and rendered in App.svelte from the hash, so it survives a reload. The SVG has role=img and aria-label `compare.profiles` = 'Profiles of {a} and {b}', with two `<path>` outlines from caseOuterProfile. The table has `<caption>` 'Dimensions (mm)'/'Dimensions (in)', headers Symbol / first.name / second.name / Difference, and a row-header symbol from FIELD_LABELS. Difference is b - a. Units follow unitSystem(). CompareControl adds a 'Compare with' label + NativeSelect of the other entries by name + a 'Compare' button that opens href.compare(current, chosen). German strings were added for every key, and shotshells are excluded from drawing (outlineOf returns null). No requirement is unmet.
evidence.s2_correctness: dimensionsOf (compare.ts) reads only record.cartridge, keeps finite numbers not ending in Tol and not in FIELD_UNITS, and skips repeating groups. Metric values use formatValue (String, no rounding). Imperial uses displayNumber(mm,'in'). The difference is computed in mm and then converted, with noise trimmed at the same 12 significant digits displayNumber uses. overlay() uses one viewportFor([a,b]) (lib/geom/svg.ts:92) so both outlines share scale, axis and zMin = 0 head face. fullSectionPath yields one closed path each. Unknown keys show a localized error, and an undrawable record shows a noProfile message. Tests check concrete values (L1 39.62/55.78, eMin 1.4/0.94, 51.18-43.48 → '7.7').
evidence.s2_fit: Reuses @lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, formatValue), @lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath), @lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile) and site units.ts, and uses the same `as unknown as CartridgeRecord` cast idiom as live.ts:83. CompareControl copies the Label/NativeSelect/$props.id pattern from GlobalSettings.svelte, and styles sit in `@layer legacy` like the other routes. Edits are limited to the route, nav highlight, metadata and i18n. Minor deviations: outline colours are hard-coded hex (#2563eb/#d97706) in Compare.svelte, where nearly all routes use theme variables, and the drawing is hand-assembled rather than going through lib/render2d.
evidence.s2_tests: site/src/lib/compare.test.ts runs under the existing Vitest include and covers row selection and order on the real 308_win/300_win_mag records: tolerance, angle, pressure and mass exclusion, cartridge-only reading, first-group precedence, metric/imperial formatting, difference direction and conversion, and shotshell/undrawable cases. It checks overlay invariants (one closed path each, common head x, common axis, equal scale, fits viewport). router.test.ts adds round-trip and malformed-URL cases. Not covered: accessible names, column headers, the caption switch and CompareControl, all of which live in the Svelte components. The repo has no component-test setup, so this is a minor gap.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: dimensionRows now walks the union of groups in sheet order and emits rows with `a`/`b` undefined where a cartridge does not publish the field. Compare.svelte renders '' for the missing value and for Difference (step3.patch l.202-204). Tests now assert that delta L has b undefined and R3 has a undefined, that rows are unique, and that the row count equals the union. Style: CSS now sets `th, td {text-align:left}` and `thead th.num, td.num {text-align:right}`, so the two cartridge columns and Difference are right-aligned with their headers while the symbol column stays left, as in GroupTable.svelte:231-245. The noCommon → noDimensions message rename in en/de follows from the new semantics. The changelog entry was updated. No unrelated changes.
evidence.cross_step: Steps 2 and 3 each add or adjust a line under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md. Under the stated strategy the version changes only in a release PR, so leaving site/package.json at 0.1.0 is consistent. Commits `feat(site): compare two cartridges` and `fix(site): list every dimension in the cartridge comparison` follow the convention. i18n keys stay in parity (the de map is typed Record<keyof typeof en>), and the new code is type-consistent (Route union, Record<Route['view'],…> in metadata.ts updated), so npm test / npm run build should pass.

unmet_requirements: Step 1 / CI criterion: GitHub Actions are pinned to version tags (@v7, @v6, @v5), not full commit SHAs
strengths: A coherent, enforced release strategy: the version lives in site/package.json, and the tag-triggered release.yml checks the tag against the version and CHANGELOG heading, then publishes notes from the changelog. Every commit follows the documented Conventional Commits convention.

The compare feature reuses the existing modules (lib/core field tables and orderedFields, lib/geom viewportFor and fullSectionPath, lib/shapes2d caseOuterProfile) and gets values, conversions and the shared-axis overlay correct.
The step 3 fix is precise: rows now cover the union of dimensions with empty cells, alignment matches the detail page's tables, and tests were updated to assert the exact delta L / R3 behaviour.
issues: All workflow actions use mutable version tags (actions/checkout@v7, setup-node@v7, configure-pages@v6, upload-pages-artifact@v5, deploy-pages@v5) instead of full commit SHAs. This is a supply-chain hardening gap in a repo that takes outside PRs.

None of the compare view's accessibility and UI requirements (SVG accessible name, caption switch, exact column headers, the Compare with control) is covered by a test. Tests stop at the framework-free helpers.
Minor style deviation: the outline colours are hard-coded hex values in Compare.svelte, where the site otherwise uses theme CSS variables.
review.verdict: This is solid, well-integrated work: the setup is thorough and consistent, and the compare view meets every requirement with correct values, units and overlay, reusing the repository's libraries. The step 3 fix is clean. The main blocker before merging is pinning the workflow actions to commit SHAs; adding component-level tests for the accessible names would also help.
